summary: SMJ International Holdings Inc., a Singapore-based flooring distributor listed on NYSE American, filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, attaching a press release issued the same day. The press release is a 'no-news' statement under NYSE American Company Guide Section 401(d) responding to unusual trading activity in its common stock on August 27, 2026. The company stated it made inquiries and cannot determine whether corrective actions are appropriate, and knows of no material nonpublic information or business developments explaining the trading activity. No transaction, deal terms, or special-situation event is involved; this is a routine market-action disclosure.
